reasons.persona_fit: Directly addresses small business owner-operators in Bareni's calm, practical voice. Accurately adheres to the no-CTA rule and explicitly enforces human approval for money movement.
reasons.clarity: Logical structure, clear distinction between when spot checks work and when to automate, and precise, accessible language throughout.
reasons.actionability: Provides an immediate, low-risk diagnostic action: measure check volume and failure rates over one week to decide between automation and manual process refinement.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no unsubstantiated capability, customer, or ROI claims. Strictly adheres to approved evidence boundaries and operating limits.
